source: OpenRouter listing price on 2026-11-17; raw responses in openrouter_qwen3.8-27b_2026-11-17.json
notes: Used only to report the cost of Qwen3.8-27B runs at the model's own price (pass with --price-card).
During a run the per-task cost budget is still computed with price_card.json (the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B card), so that every model gets the same token allowance.
Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens.
Implicit prompt caching: a cached prompt prefix is billed at cache_read, there is no cache-write fee.
